category_title: Senior primary boys with literacy underachievement and playground behavioral challenges
minimal_context: The student is sitting in the classroom working on a story writing task during a long literacy period.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please sit at your desk and spend this period writing your story.

STUDENT: I don't want to do writing. It's just boring stuff and there is lots of work.

TUTOR: You need to complete your planned tasks for today.

STUDENT: I hate having to do stuff like this. I'd rather be outside playing tackle games with my friends.

TUTOR: Just do your best and keep working on it.

STUDENT: (Displays complete inattention and lack of focus on tasks) No, I'm done. This is too much work and I'm just going to mess around until it's time to go to the playground.

options.A: Play the music of W. A. Mozart in the classroom while the student works on the story writing task.
options.B: Provide autocorrect and text prediction functions on a classroom tablet for the student during the story writing task.
options.C: Use hands-on activities and relate the story writing task to the student's interests rather than just the curriculum.
options.D: Implement relatively tight timelines for the student to complete the story writing task during the long literacy period.
